title: SBPS students selected for the 38th National Games, Uttarakhand
excerpt: Students of Social Baluni Public School were selected to compete in the 38th National Games in shooting, badminton, fencing, archery and kalaripayattu.
author: Social Baluni Public School
body:
Students of Social Baluni Public School were selected to compete in the 38th National Games, held in Uttarakhand.

- 2 students in Shooting
- 5 students in Badminton
- 10 students in Fencing
- 3 students in Archery
- 3 students in Kalaripayattu

Congratulations to the students and their coaches.
